defect_observations.observation: Says the source gives computational recipes for independent inputs only. At p. 1512, Section 5.4 the article gives no recipe of its own: it refers the independent-input recipe to Saltelli (2002) and Saltelli et al. (2010) and the dependent case to Saltelli and Tarantola (2002) and Da Veiga et al. (2009). No component verdict depends on this sentence.

Appeals to 'the measurable-factorization result for real coordinate tuples' without a cross-reference; the proved handbook result is thm:p15-conditional-factorization (handbook/parts/p15/conditional-expectation.tex line 213).

The citation [Section 5.2] is attached to the claim that collinearity can make individual coefficient rankings non-unique. Section 5.2 (p. 1511) does not discuss collinearity; it says that a low R^2 makes coefficient rankings pointless and that the squared coefficients sum to R^2 for independent factors.

States that, under the product law, conditional expectation is integration over the other coordinates, giving only 'justified by Fubini' and not writing out the check of the defining property. The p15-069 annex at lines 170-176 does write that check. The C03 verdict does not rest on this step alone: direct derivations from conditional means and variances are written at global annex 235-249 and p15-069 annex 47-139.
